Product Manager at Coinbase

I build products where regulated finance meets crypto markets.

I’m a product manager who ships financial infrastructure in one of the hardest domains there is — global crypto derivatives, inside the perimeters regulators draw. I ship regulated financial products for retail users on Coinbase Advanced and institutional clients on Coinbase Prime — and the exchanges behind them. The products I’m proudest of didn’t exist before we shipped them: the first US-regulated route to global crypto derivatives, the industry’s first automated margin calls, and two exchanges built from zero.

About me

I'm a product manager in New York. I build products at the seam where traditional financial markets and crypto infrastructure have to meet — the ones that decide what a position costs to hold, when it gets unwound, and who is exposed when it does, all inside the perimeters regulators draw. I build regulated financial products for retail users on Coinbase Advanced and institutional clients on Coinbase Prime, powered by the exchanges underneath. Building products is what I do first and foremost; deep risk and derivatives is the domain I do it in.

I'm a Product Manager at Coinbase Financial Markets, our US-regulated FCM, which this year became the first to connect US clients to global crypto derivatives. I joined Coinbase in 2021 pre-IPO as the 4th hire on the Credit Risk team, then built and shipped the core infrastructure behind Coinbase International Exchange and our FCM — the margin engine, the auto-liquidation waterfall, the position limits — work that gave me the domain depth I now bring to product. Before crypto, I underwrote counterparty risk at Morgan Stanley and J.P. Morgan.

My first product was Retail Borrow, bitcoin-backed loans for US retail customers, where I built the risk and liquidation framework. Everything since has been a version of the same question at larger size: who is exposed when the collateral moves, and how gently can you unwind them.

I have an MBA from NYU Stern, earned while working full time, and I spend most of my time on the tail — risk products are judged on the worst hour of the worst week, not the median.

May 2026Coinbase Financial Markets

Global derivatives, opened to US customers

Derivatives are roughly 80% of global crypto trading volume, and until this year US clients had no regulated way in — some institutions stood up offshore entities just to get there. Coinbase Financial Markets became the first and only US-regulated FCM connecting US clients to global perps and options.

I helped develop the risk framework behind Coinbase Financial Markets’ CFTC/NFA application, and built OTC options for US customers on Coinbase Prime plugged into Deribit’s global liquidity — the piece that let US clients reach that book at all.

2023Founding team

Coinbase International Exchange

Built from scratch as a regulated, institutional-grade offshore derivatives exchange — now processing $281B+ in 30-day trading volume, with $40B+ of open interest across 200+ tradable markets.

I joined before it launched and helped build the infrastructure from the ground up — the core exchange systems and risk framework: auto-liquidation engine, margin models, capital efficiency features, and the governance infrastructure that manages exposure across our client base. Years later, that same infrastructure supports billions in trading volume and is a foundational part of Coinbase’s derivatives offering.

E*TRADE integration

The risk framework

The rulebook a regulated venue launches on: margin tiers, position limits, trade controls, and the conditions under which the exchange stops accepting a trade.

[Your part — the tradeoff you argued for, and who you had to convince.]

24/7
2024Product

The auto-liquidation engine

How a position unwinds when margin runs out — fast enough that one failing account never reaches the insurance fund, let alone the rest of the book. Unwind too slowly and the loss outruns the collateral; too fast and you move the market against everyone.

I built the auto-liquidation engine, the automated liquidation waterfall, and the market-making backstop liquidity program behind it — the layered defence that keeps one failing account from reaching the fund.

40+
2024 – 2025Product

Margin models

What a position costs to hold across perps, dated futures, options and spot — and how much correlated risk the venue will let a trader net against it. Clients can post cross-collateral across 40+ assets against a single balance.

[Your part — the stress case where you refused to net.]

2025Product

Capital efficiency and off-exchange settlement

Institutions need collateral at the venue to trade with size, but assets sitting on an exchange are assets they no longer control. Copper's ClearLoop lets clients hold assets in MPC custody, trade on the exchange, and settle near real-time. Ethena came in as a day-one launch partner.
